fields.name: button_pressed
fields.description: `no` at step #1 (nothing has happened yet). `yes` at every step from the one whose execution steps show the button pressed down (gripper descended onto the button) onward, i.e. from step #2 to the end of the episode. e.g. yes

fields.name: pending_cubes
fields.description: Ordered list of [y, x] positions of cubes that sit on highlighted white areas and have not yet been picked up. `[]` at step #1. At the step whose execution steps show the highlighted areas (the button-press step, #2), write one entry per highlighted area: the [y, x] of the cube whose position is nearest that area. Order the entries in the sequence the episode actually picks those cubes up, as read from the later pick-up steps, so the cube picked up next is always the first entry. At each later step whose execution steps show a cube newly marked 'is held in the gripper', remove the entry nearest the table position that cube had in the execution step just before it was lifted, keeping the remaining entries in their order; the list is unchanged at a place step. e.g. [[118, 147], [70, 152]]
